# 03-system

Safety requirements specification, SRP/CS architecture, response-time, fall-arrest and stopping budget, safety-chain I/O, installation and tether requirements, cybersecurity architecture, system integration and verification.

Standard clauses: ISO 13849-1 §5–§6 and §8, IEC 62061 §6, IEC 60204-1 §9, ISO 13482 §6, IEC 62443-4-1 SD, ASPICE SYS.2–5.
